"use server"
// PROBE — must turn tests/unit/agent-action-input-validation.test.ts RED.
// An exported action that writes a Policy straight from its argument.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"

export async function addPolicyProbe(data: { customerId: string; startDate: string }) {
    const created = await db.policy.create({
        data: { ownerUserId: data.customerId, startDate: new Date(data.startDate) },
    })
    return { success: true, policyId: created.id }
}
